# BGP (`bgp`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: 19 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Routing protocols](../../protocols/routing.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`tcp`](tcp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 179 (0x00b3) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `marker` | `bytes(16)` | `ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff` |   | 16-octet marker (all ones). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the BGP message including the header, in octets (Auto). |
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `4` (keepalive) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | BGP message type (OPEN / UPDATE / NOTIFICATION / KEEPALIVE / ROUTE-REFRESH; Auto from the next layer). |

### `type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `open` |
| 2 (0x02) | `update` |
| 3 (0x03) | `notification` |
| 4 (0x04) | `keepalive` |
| 5 (0x05) | `route_refresh` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | [`bgp_open`](bgp_open.md) |   |
| 2 (0x02) | [`bgp_update`](bgp_update.md) |   |
| 3 (0x03) | [`bgp_notification`](bgp_notification.md) |   |
| 5 (0x05) | [`bgp_route_refresh`](bgp_route_refresh.md) |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| error | header and payload at least 19 octets |
| warning | header and payload at most 4096 octets |
